hints.title: Consecutive Group Run-Length Reduction
hints.text: Group consecutive identical characters into run lengths. For example, "00110" groups into counts [2, 2, 1].

hints.title: Adjacent Group Minimum Pairing
hints.text: Any two adjacent groups of zeros and ones can form min(count1, count2) balanced substrings centered at their boundary.

hints.title: Single-Pass Streaming Summation
hints.text: Track the previous group length and current group length. When character changes, add min(prev, cur) to total, set prev = cur, and reset cur to 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings takes O(N^2) time and causes timeouts on large strings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking only the previous and current run lengths requires O(1) memory across a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only adjacent groups of opposing bits can form contiguous valid substrings.
